method: A-B-B-A-A-B, three fresh browser contexts/processes per version, identical frozen VSCode input, corrected camera path, workload and instrumented harness. Baseline application bundle is from the exact archived merge; only harness files were overlaid.
limitations: Three samples per version; no statistical or cross-platform guarantee. Whole-workload FPS retains every stall. DOM counts are not handler invocations; submitted bytes are not actual GPU traffic or memory footprint.

environment.gpuFlags: No GPU-disabling flags supplied. Headless Chrome compositor/GPU behavior may differ from a visible browser.

workload.layoutTransition: collapse first expanded directory; 300ms renderer transition
workload.selectionInput: keyboard Enter on first accessible entity

phaseTiming.limitation: Automation wall time includes Playwright dispatch and waits. It is reported separately from browser Event Timing and frame intervals.

frames.phaseAttribution: Phase FPS counts callback deliveries in the half-open browser-clock window. Interval statistics include entire intervals whose callback span intersects the window, including boundary stalls; adjacent phases may share an interval. Phase summaries are not additive and do not replace the unchanged whole-run score.

browserMeasurements.inputLimitation: Observed DOM delivery counts, not renderer-handler invocations or input-to-paint latency. Compare counts and camera trajectories between variants; do not assume a fixed event count or no browser coalescing.
browserMeasurements.bufferLimitation: Observed API calls and submitted byte ranges, not GPU execution time, buffer ownership, texture transfers, resident memory, or verified GL success. specifiedStorageBytes sums requested bufferData storage, including replacements; unknown byte ranges and JavaScript throws are explicit.

inputToNextPaint.limitation: Browser Event Timing measures trusted input start through the next presentation opportunity and is duration-quantized. Empty means Chrome emitted no qualifying entry; handler time is not substituted.

memory.limitation: JavaScript heap only. It excludes DOM, SVG backing storage, PixiJS GPU buffers/textures, driver memory, and browser process overhead.

graphics.gpuRenderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5 Pro, Unspecified Version)
